import pytest
import click
from click.testing import CliRunner

def test_multiline_help_text_fish_completion():
    runner = CliRunner()

    @click.command()
    @click.option(
        "--at",
        "--attachment-type",
        type=(str, str),
        multiple=True,
        help="\b\nAttachment with explicit mimetype,\n--at image.jpg image/jpeg",
    )
    def cli(at):
        pass

    result = runner.invoke(
        cli,
        ["--"],
        catch_exceptions=True,
        env={"_LLM_COMPLETE": "fish_complete", "COMP_WORDS": "cli --", "COMP_CWORD": "--"},
    )
    assert result.exit_code == 0
